title: Recruited by the American Orthodox Catholic Church outside the funeral

tellings.quote: because on our way out, we bump into guys from the American Orthodox Catholic Church,

plain: Around 1968 or 1969, as Peter Levenda left a funeral in the Bronx in New York City, he says men from a small church called the American Orthodox Catholic Church came up to him and drew him in: "on our way out, we bump into guys from the American Orthodox Catholic Church." Levenda, an author presented on the show as a historian of the CIA, tells it as his own experience. To him it was the start of his time inside a strange world of small churches and secret groups.
